race_description.description: Human humanoid anatomy: one torso, head and back; two arms and hands; a paired-feet group. Physical mutations require their actual body variant.
race_description.description_kind: Source-derived anatomy summary; native Humanoid has no race-wide Description.Short. No occupation or named posture inferred.

captured_actor.description:
Big Yrame shifts her weight between hind and forelegs. She shakes a storm of rust dander from the tines of her great horns, and she blows a halo of freezing air from her rime-veined hands.
{{C|-----}}
Loved by {{C|the Fellowship of Wardens}}.

Admired by {{C|the villagers of Joppa}} for defending their village.

Disliked by {{C|the villagers of Tuwan}} for disparaging a famous poet.

Disliked by {{C|trees}} for eating one of their young.

anatomy.baseline: Reuse unmutated female human body/head and original two arms/hands and paired legs/feet unchanged.
anatomy.additions: One separate extra leg/foot pair: Feet297/16 changed and Feet298/64 added. The paired Feet type has Mobility2 and plural=true; native description explicitly distinguishes hind and forelegs. Four physical feet is the supported interpretation, not mutation Level6 interpreted as six legs.

anatomy.algorithm_summary: Installed MultipleLegs adds one Feet group, changes the original group laterality to16 and assigns Add/Change managers. Do not turn grouped slots into render bones.
anatomy.equipment: Horns, mail, blade and boots stay separate current fitting entries. Boots580 occupy only Feet297/16, not both pairs. Icy Vapor remains native natural equipment metadata.

interpretation.no_whole_body_equivalent: Core female cardinal assets supply ordinary human rendering and shading only. No whole four-legged-human donor equivalent is claimed; additional-leg geometry must be authored from Qud facts.
interpretation.geometry: Pelvis attachment, spacing, overlap and unseen surfaces remain authored interpretations. Preserve the existing shared body and item frame/contact; do not repeat the rejected three-foot silhouette.
interpretation.palette: Native tileColor w and detail B are retained. Per-component assignments require a recorded authoring decision; prose freezing vapour is not permission to flood blue into the neutral base.
interpretation.cosmetics: Keep face blank. No new personal hair, eyes, scars, veins or freezing particles in this body phase.
interpretation.native: No mutation framework, native body activation, game launch or lifecycle/animation acceptance during generation.
